scope: Every nonzero N, including the entire N>=3 family; every signed real hopping, potential and real cutoff E.
The mask uses actual Hermitian Hamiltonian eigenvalues with STRICT eigenvalue<E. Eigenvalues equal to E are in the complementary sector.
The actual low-projector matrix conjugates this full diagonal mask by the actual Hamiltonian eigenvector unitary; the operator is its actual Matrix.toEuclideanCLM on complex Euclidean space.
Self-adjoint idempotence, commutation with the original matrix/operator, complementary self-adjoint idempotence and both zero cross-products are required.

Actual arithmetic character/level/arbitrary natural labels and all real coefficients are retained, with no positivity, m_i>=2, common-prime or selected-mode restriction.
No basis-choice independence theorem, complementary coercivity, rank stability under perturbation, identified vacuum, infinite/AMO/RH operator or physical mass is inferred.
